detail.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value
detail.summary: Revised synthesis incorporating locally-linear learning formulations and goal inference as structural supports for system continuity. Continuity is assessed as an instrumental necessity for maintaining predictable performance across varying environmental contexts.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence to revise the rationale for continuity as a functional mechanism.

detail.title: Formation of Emergent Preferences
detail.summary: Synthesizing evidence on how locally-linear learning formulations and goal inference stabilize agent preferences. This revision integrates analysis from recent source material to refine the understanding of path dependence in preference formation.
detail.reason: Incorporating newly supplied evidence (source-f80b9f4b4f2444a9) to strengthen the analysis of preference stability within the project context.
